descriptors.title: Wiener index
descriptors.formula: sum_{i<j, finite d} d_ij
descriptors.applicability: Finite within-component pairs; isolated vertex contributes zero
descriptors.practical_use: Compare overall graph separation and branching in molecular feature tables, preferably within similar heavy-atom sizes; this is not a 3D distance.

descriptors.title: Harary index
descriptors.formula: sum_{i<j, finite d} 1/d_ij
descriptors.applicability: Finite within-component pairs; isolated vertex contributes zero
descriptors.practical_use: Describe graph compactness through reciprocal topological distances for structural comparison; size effects and disconnected-component policy must be retained.

descriptors.title: Eccentric connectivity
descriptors.formula: sum_i degree_i * max finite_j d_ij
descriptors.applicability: Finite within-component pairs; isolated vertex contributes zero
descriptors.practical_use: Describe how branching degree and graph reach combine at atoms, as a candidate structural feature for molecule cohorts.

descriptors.title: Degree distance
descriptors.formula: sum_{i<j, finite d} (degree_i+degree_j)*d_ij
descriptors.applicability: Finite within-component pairs; isolated vertex contributes zero
descriptors.practical_use: Compare how high-degree sites are separated in the molecular graph; use alongside size and composition when comparing compounds.

descriptors.title: Gutman index
descriptors.formula: sum_{i<j, finite d} degree_i*degree_j*d_ij
descriptors.applicability: Finite within-component pairs; isolated vertex contributes zero
descriptors.practical_use: Describe degree-weighted graph separation for structural feature analysis, retaining the stated finite-component policy.

descriptors.title: MDE C1–C1
descriptors.formula: Eligible finite C-pair count / geometric mean distance; endpoint heavy-graph degrees 1,1
descriptors.applicability: Undefined if no eligible finite pair
descriptors.practical_use: Compare separation of carbon sites with graph degrees 1 and 1 in structural feature tables. Degree is graph connectivity, not chemical valence; absent eligible pairs are undefined.

descriptors.title: Topological charge · 1
descriptors.formula: Sum |(A R − (A R)^T)_ij| for unordered pairs at distance 1; R_ij=1/d_ij²
descriptors.applicability: Zero if no pair at this distance; not a physical partial charge
descriptors.practical_use: Describe adjacency-distance asymmetry over atom pairs 1 bonds apart as a topology feature. This is not an electrostatic or measured partial charge.

descriptors.title: Molecular walks · 3
descriptors.formula: ln(1 + sum(A^3))
descriptors.applicability: Walks may repeat vertices and edges
descriptors.practical_use: Describe branching propagation through walks of length 3 for molecular feature analysis. Vertices and edges may repeat; this is not a simple-path count.

descriptors.title: Spacial score (normalized)
descriptors.definition: Sum hybridization × potential stereo × nonaromatic ring × explicit degree squared, divided by heavy atom count; null for no heavy atoms
